The '''Pinnacle Room''' was a circular chamber located at the peak of the [[Temple Spire/Legends|Temple Spire]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SWCL" /> Within this chamber, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] housed its most sacred text in environment-controlled storage units. Chairs could also be brought in to host meetings of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] in addition to the main [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]].<ref name="Voices" /><ref name="SWCWJunior">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]]</ref><ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

==History==
After the original Temple was destroyed during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Sacking of Coruscant]], the Order was eventually able to raise enough funds with the help of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to start reconstruction on [[Temple Spire/Legends|Tranquillity Spire]]. In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the Spire was completed and the pinnacle room established at the summit of the tower.<ref name="SWCL" /> Located directly above the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple's veranda]], the pinnacle room held the oldest and most sacred of the Order's texts and documents. Salvaged from the lost [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Library]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], the ancient manuscripts were kept in a carefully controlled environment<ref name="SWCL" /> and maintained by the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]] and the slew of [[Lore Keeper]]s stationed at the Temple.<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Pinnacle Room was a primary meeting place of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="NoP" /> During the conclusion of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Temple was [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|raided]] by the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] led by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Ravaging the Temple, Vader secured the ancient texts, leaving them in the hands of his master [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. After the roof was bombed by [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT gunships]],<ref name="ROTSvg">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref> Tranquility Spire was left listing, its interior crumbling.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>
